prompt:
Scene:
Same gothic nave as the reference, same single-point perspective, same camera height and lens. Midnight vigil: almost no ambient light in the stone; the only illumination is the holographic rose window, which has dimmed to a slow-pulsing deep magenta, and one floating amber candle at the crossing.

Subject:
The identical rib-vaulted nave and identical rose-window hologram, now in near-black stillness. A single kneeling silhouette sits at the crossing, facing the apse, with one large hovering amber candle halo right above them. The AR scripture ribbons above have contracted into tight coiled spirals like resting fish. Faint bioluminescent dust drifts along the floor.

Important details:
Preserve exact nave geometry, column spacing, rib-vault cadence, rose window position, left/right symmetry, vanishing point. Contrast is extreme: deep black stone versus saturated magenta-pink glow. Candle halo casts a real, finite pool of warm light on the floor that is visibly different from the cold rose projection. No added figures beyond the single kneeler. Keep the mood utterly quiet.

Use case:
Hologram Cathedral Nave series image 4/4, depends on the reference nave; demonstrates the same architecture during a midnight vigil.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no visible face, no printed cloth, no flames with brand-like shapes, no modern electronics on the floor, keep the same nave identity as the reference.
